summary: Reject malformed transition receipts and anchor rejected trace events

delivery.outcome: Return stable diagnostics without fabricating a receipt for malformed transition input; rejected trace events preserve counters/phase and remain anchored to the preceding accepted state. Publish immutable standard 0.20.67.
nonGoals: Change or deploy the effectful Subactor controller
Grant authority through local replay or alter the canonical lease schema
Mutate foreign or frozen target work
Change scalar contract or allocated local identity

architecture.decision: Separate malformed document diagnostics from valid transition receipts. Validate rejected receipts against unchanged own state and the preceding accepted trace anchor; only accepted receipts advance that anchor. Reuse the existing portable safety suite and package synchronizer.
interfaceChanges: Malformed CLI transition evaluation returns its structured diagnostic report, without a fabricated transition receipt.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Malformed transition inputs produce stable diagnostics and no receipt; rejected receipts cannot advance or escape accepted identity/state; valid rejection preserves the next accepted transition.
Existing validator integration, parity, native gate and required exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and final immutable standard v0.20.67 publication are verified.
